title: A Portrait for the Bell
author: Juniper Delacroix
blurb: Ines Quintana, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
